summary: Audited the 23 long tracts in src/data/tracts.json (14 fields each: name, synonyms, direction, modality, origin, target, decussation, somatotopy, function, clinical, waypoints, tubeRadius, levels, refs) and the 15 plate manifests + SVGs in src/data/plates.json + src/data/plates/*.svg (360 labelled regions). NO DATA FILE WAS EDITED (read-only on the whole repository, per the run rules). Deliverables: docs/audit/v15/tracts-plates.findings.json (345 findings, all 11 required keys each, verdict in {ok,wrong,suspect,unverifiable-here}, severity in {critical,major,minor}) and docs/audit/v15/tracts-plates.md (methods, per-finding evidence, per-plate inventory, hand-off list; its counts are generated from the JSON so the two cannot drift). Summary: 333 ok / 8 wrong / 4 suspect, 0 unverifiable-here; 0 critical, 5 major, 340 minor; 322 findings on tracts, 23 on plates. Twelve non-ok findings, strongest first: (1) tract-optic-radiation.levels lists lvl-tel-thalamostriate(y48) and lvl-tel-convexity(y78) while the record's OWN waypoints span only y 14-30, and its last waypoint (13,30,-66) is 14.7 au from the model's own ctx-v1 origin [9.5,17,-60] - internal contradiction inside one record, major; (2) plate-thalamus-mid A/P marker letters are inverted (P at cy=62 top, A at cy=738 bottom) while the plate's own drawing puts the pulvinar/MGN (model z -5.5/-4.5) at the top and the anterior nucleus/mammillary body (z +4.0) at the bottom, and all 8 other transverse plates put A at the bottom - wrong, major, fix = swap the two letters only; (3) plate-sagittal-midline A/P marker letters inverted (A at x=52 with the optic chiasm at x=318 and the pineal at x=543) - wrong, major, fix = swap the two letters only; (4) tract-hypothalamospinal.target claims the T1-L2 intermediolateral column although its own course ends at the cervicomedullary junction (y -52) and the atlas has no cord geometry - suspect, major; (5) 6 leader dots that miss their own shape, worst the vent-cerebral-aqueduct on plate-sagittal-midline (30 px off, landing in the fourth-ventricle/cerebellar field); (6) tract-trigeminothalamic-dorsal.function states the contested uncrossed route as the established explanation (suspect, minor) and tract-mlf.tubeRadius gives the MLF a 0.96 mm tube, level with tracts an order of magnitude larger (suspect, minor). Clean measurements backing the ok verdicts: 23/23 waypoint sets inside CLIP_BOUNDS (min clearance 3.00 au), 0 duplicate/unresolvable level ids, all 9 midline crossings exactly where the record's own decussation sentence says, 23/23 direction-vs-origin/target order consistent, tube radii 0.40-0.90 au (the brief's 'uniform radius' premise does not reproduce), 360/360 plate labels matched to manifest slugs and shapes with 0 labelPos/SVG-text disagreements, 0 laterality defects, 10/10 transverse plates carry a levelId and the 5 without one are exactly the 2 sagittal + 3 coronal plates (correct), 0 plate titles contradicting their content. Verified with: npm run validate (exit 0, 0 errors / 0 warnings - unchanged), the evidence-contract findings-parse command (exit 0, prints 'findings 345'), an independent self-consistency check that the verdict/severity counts in the .md equal those in the .json (true) and that every finding carries all 11 keys (0 missing), and git status confirming no src/** file was modified by this task. Scope deviation, per the architect's plan of record (PLAN-run-mtze6lyq-t83x.md C2): the 12 cranial-nerve courses are NERVE_COURSES in src/geometry/curves.ts, not tract records, and belong to the audit-vessels-nerves task - they were not audited here. No finding rests on a rendered pixel; the browser lane cannot run in this sandbox and nothing of the sort was claimed.
